name: NIPSCO
notes: Researched from public nipsco.com pages only (NiSource; same program structure as Columbia Gas of Ohio). Bank-account payments require a NIPSCO.com account and are free; card, debit, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal and Venmo payments go through Paymentus for $2.00 per transaction (rising to $2.40 residential / $12.95 non-residential, expected late 2026; current fee used). Pay without signing in = card/wallet only, so guestMethods is card. AutoPay withdraws the full amount due (including past-due) from checking or savings; withdrawal day not published; cancel with Edit Enrollment > Cancel Enrollment; enrollment also by uploaded AutoPay Application. Paperless under Account Enrollments > Enroll Now. Stop service online (residential and small commercial) needs account number, SSN/TIN, date of birth; submit at least one business day ahead. Sign-in identifier and MFA not documented (family defaults). Reviewer: payment plans added from the Payment Plans page (6/12-month plans enroll online; 3-month plan by phone).

autopay_cancel.note: Sign in, select Edit Enrollment, then Cancel Enrollment.

cancel_service.note: Submit your request at least one business day before the stop date. Call 1-800-464-7726 if you need help.

payment_arrangement.note: Six- and 12-month payment plans can be set up online and start with a down payment. For a three-month plan or another arrangement, call 1-800-464-7726.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Paying from your bank account requires a NIPSCO.com online account and has no fee. Credit card, debit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal and Venmo payments are processed by Paymentus for a $2.00 convenience fee per transaction, shown before you submit. You can pay this way without signing in.

Paymentus fees are expected to rise in late 2026 to $2.40 for residential and $12.95 for non-residential payments. To avoid the fee, pay from a bank account in your registered account, enroll in AutoPay, or use your bank's bill pay.

You can also pay by phone at 1-855-763-6277 ($2.00 fee), at an authorized payment location, or by mailing a check or money order with your account number to NIPSCO, P.O. Box 13007, Merrillville, IN 46411-3007.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: AutoPay withdraws the full amount due each month, including any past-due balance, from your checking or savings account. Your monthly bill still shows the payment amount and date.
Enroll in your online account, or complete the fillable AutoPay Application and upload it through the document upload form.

help.title: Cancel AutoPay
paragraphs: Sign in, select Edit Enrollment and then Cancel Enrollment. You can enroll again later with new payment account details.
steps: Sign in to your NIPSCO account.

help.title: Paperless Billing
paragraphs: Sign in, go to Account Enrollments, click Enroll Now beside Paperless Billing, agree to the terms, click Enroll and confirm your email. Each month you get an email with the amount due and due date; you may get one more paper bill after enrolling. Paperless billing does not change how you pay.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: Residential and small commercial customers can stop service online. Have your account number, the primary account holder's name, phone, SSN or TIN and date of birth, the stop date, the service address and a mailing address ready, and submit at least one business day before the stop date.
For help, call 1-800-464-7726. If you take part in Customer Choice, it ends at that address when service is stopped.

help.title: Payment Plans
paragraphs: If you need more time to pay, a Six Month or 12 Month Standard payment plan can be set up online through Enroll Online; each plan starts with a down payment. To ask about the Three Month Standard plan or a different arrangement, call customer care at 1-800-464-7726.
Levelized Billing lets you pay about the same amount each month, based on your usage, the weather and projected costs.

extra.intent: Using the NIPSCO website's help pages, find the current convenience fee for paying by credit or debit card. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
